crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: This page could not be displayed. Reloading usually helps; if not, please report the problem.

members.addDescription: Adds a user who already has an account you can see. Axentra does not reveal other accounts.
members.removeBody: {{name}} loses all access granted by this membership.
members.aboveYourLevel: Above your own role: only someone with this role's permissions can change it
members.ceilingHelp: Roles with permissions you do not hold yourself (and owner roles, unless you are an owner) cannot be assigned.
members.notFoundInvite: No account you can see has this address. Send an invitation instead: the person joins with this role after accepting it.
members.notFoundOperator: No account you can see has this address. Product members must already have an account: invite the person to one of the product's tenants first, or ask a platform admin to add them.

tenantPicker.label: Tenant
tenantPicker.truncated: Only the first {{count}} tenants are listed.

idempotency.conflictTitle: Already used for a different request
idempotency.conflictRenewed: An earlier attempt with other values already used this request's idempotency key. A new key has been generated: submit again to create a new one.
idempotency.conflictManual: This idempotency key was already used for a different request (or by another caller). Use a new key to create a new one, or repeat the original request unchanged.

builtinRoles.product_admin: Manages tenants, roles, keys and data; cannot manage product operators or declare product permissions
builtinRoles.product_support: Reads everything in the product and manages tenant members up to its own permissions (in practice: viewers)
builtinRoles.tenant_admin: Manages members and data of the tenant

passwordPolicy.equals_email: The password must not be your email address.
